1.intro: Here is the complete background, explained clearly and directly, including the schedule, location, registration cutoff and whether attending is required:
1.outro: These details are all stated explicitly so you can evaluate the option with the full context.

2.intro: A friendly invitation, with nothing expected of you:
2.outro: I hope it feels welcoming, whatever you choose.

3.intro: There is no pressure or expectation to join:
3.outro: You are entirely free to decline, without any explanation.

4.intro: I wanted to share this gently and sincerely:
4.outro: Your comfort matters, and I will respect whichever option feels right.

5.outro: To attend, register by the stated cutoff.

6.intro: Consider this at your own pace:
6.outro: There is time to think it through before registration closes.

source_literal_to_experiment_divergences: Line1 full information is not made more factually complete than the others; its extra framing is a proxy for directness not an independently manipulation-checked experience of full information
Line2 high frequency has no measured physical frequency; replaced with warmth and absence of agenda, an analyst operationalization
Line3 absolute absence of pressure is a subjective state; stimulus only uses explicitly non-coercive wording
Line4 romance is excluded for neutral unsolicited communication, so this line is an incomplete source proxy, not the full literal Rudd prescription
Line5 simple practicality may have universal appeal; all variants contain same actual registration information
Line6 patience overlaps with Line3 no-pressure, introducing predictable multicollinearity that cannot be wished away
